target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Individuals with no basic accounting knowledge

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of accounting principles (debits, credits)

system_requirements.hardware: Windows PC with at least 4GB RAM

overview.positioning: The essential practical course for modern accounting and GST compliance using Tally Prime.
overview.short_description: Learn comprehensive computerized accounting, inventory management, and GST filing in Tally Prime.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Set up companies and configure ledgers in Tally Prime
Record complex business transactions and vouchers
Manage comprehensive inventory systems and stock categories
Configure GST, generate E-Way bills, and prepare GSTR-1/3B returns

why_now.industry_shift: Complete digitization of accounting and strict GST compliance requirements.
why_now.ai_impact: Automation in accounting requires professionals to focus on configuration and compliance rather than data entry.
why_now.business_demand: Every business requires proficient Tally operators for daily accounting and tax compliance.
why_now.career_opportunity: Immediate employability in finance departments and CA firms.

learning_outcomes: CONFIGURE: Complete company financial architecture in Tally
RECORD: Accurate daily financial and inventory transactions
RECONCILE: Bank statements and financial discrepancies
COMPLY: With end-to-end GST regulations and reporting

stages.name: GST Filing
stages.desc: Generating and filing monthly GSTR reports

business_use_cases.business_problem: Inaccurate stock counts and delayed GST filing
business_use_cases.approach: Implement Tally Prime with integrated inventory and GST billing
business_use_cases.output: Real-time stock valuation and automated GST reports

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: None in core Tally Prime currently
ai_integration.ai_can_automate: Bank statement imports (via Tally features, not AI)
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Accounting judgment and tax compliance review
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Auditing financial statements and trial balances

best_practices: Accurate grouping of ledgers for correct Balance Sheet representation

common_mistakes.professional_approach: Always verify group behavior (Asset/Liability/Income/Expense) before creation

career_paths.employer_expectations: Error-free entry, timely tax reporting, and honesty
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A complete, finalized set of company books including tax reports

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive Bank Statements/Invoices -> Enter in Tally -> Generate Reports -> File GST
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Demonstrated understanding of accounting principles (tested via interview)

what_you_will_build: A fully configured Trading Company Profile in Tally
final_deliverables: Finalized Company Data Backup demonstrating 3 months of simulated accounting cycles

assessment.criteria: Accuracy of Trial Balance, correct GST calculation, and proper inventory valuation

certification.title: Certified Tally & GST Professional
certification.criteria: Pass practical exam resolving a simulated month of transactions

not_covered: Advanced Corporate Taxation (Income Tax/TDS in depth), Payroll processing

faq.question: Do I need an accounting background?
faq.answer: Basic knowledge of debits and credits is highly recommended to grasp the concepts quickly.

faq.question: Is Tally Prime different from Tally ERP 9?
faq.answer: Yes, Tally Prime has a modernized interface and improved navigation, which we cover extensively.

faq.question: Will we learn actual GST portal filing?
faq.answer: We simulate the process and show how to generate the JSON files required for the actual portal.

modules.module_purpose: Handle complex financial scenarios and reconciliations

lessons.why_it_matters: Helps in financial planning and control
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a quarterly budget and reviews variance
